Candidate withdrawals

Bo Baker has withdrawn from the race for School Director.

The name was certified before the withdrawal and stays on the printed ballot.

This page is published for general information about the election. Voters with questions about where, when or how to vote should contact the election office during business hours, or read the guides the office publishes before each election. Nothing on this page endorses any candidate, party or ballot question, and the office does not answer questions about the positions of any candidate. Corrections to this page are posted here as soon as they are made, and earlier versions are kept on request.
